target.title: fix(zai): keep probe deadline through stalled error-body reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Z.AI endpoint detection could hang indefinitely when a probe returned error headers and then stalled on the error response body. The previous helper cleared the AbortSignal as soon as `fetch` resolved headers, so a never-chunking error body bypassed the probe deadline.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep one AbortController deadline across the probe request and the bounded error-body read, and pass `chunkTimeoutMs` / `onIdleTimeout` into `readResponseWithLimit` so a stalled error body fails closed inside the same budget. Malformed, oversized, and stalled bodies remain swallowed so classification still falls back to status-only behavior.

## User Impact

**Before:** A stalled Z.AI probe error body could hang endpoint detection past the configured timeout.

**After:** Probe error-body reads fail closed within the probe timeout and detection continues or returns null without hanging.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/zai/detect.ts`, `extensions/zai/detect.test.ts`
- Production caller path: `detectZaiEndpoint` → `probeZaiChatCompletions` → `readResponseWithLimit(..., { chunkTimeoutMs })`

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

Stalled Z.AI probe error bodies no longer hang past the probe deadline.

### Canonical reachability path

`detectZaiEndpoint({ endpoint: "global", timeoutMs, fetchFn })` → `probeZaiChatCompletions` → `readResponseWithLimit` with `chunkTimeoutMs`.

### Real environment tested

Real HTTP transport: a local `node:http` server on `127.0.0.1` that returns `400` headers plus one error-body chunk (`{"error":{"code":"1234","message":"`) and then never sends another chunk or ends the response. The branch's `detectZaiEndpoint` production path is driven directly against that live socket through an injected `fetchFn`, Node v22.23.1.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
# Boot a real HTTP server that returns 400 + one chunk then stalls, then
# drive the branch's detectZaiEndpoint against it (probe deadline 300ms):
node --import tsx scripts/proof-zai-idle-timeout.mts

# Supplemental focused regression:
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zai/detect.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

### Evidence after fix

Real HTTP stall (production probe path against a live socket):

```text
  ok: detectZaiEndpoint returned (did not hang) — elapsed=308ms
  ok: stalled probe classified as no-match (null) — null
  ok: terminated within probe deadline budget — elapsed=308ms
  ok: unbounded error-body read still hanging after 2000ms — state=still-hanging

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS PASSED
```

Supplemental focused regression:

```text
✓ detectZaiEndpoint > fails closed when a probe error body stalls without chunks 81ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 11.51s
```

### Observed result after fix

Against a real stalled HTTP socket, `detectZaiEndpoint` completes in ~308ms (bounded by the 300ms probe deadline) and returns `null` instead of hanging. The negative control — reading the same stalled error body with no idle timeout — is still unresolved after a 2000ms observation window, confirming the pre-fix hang. Oversized/malformed regression cases still pass.

### What was not tested

Live Z.AI network stall against production endpoints.

### Fix classification

bugfix — timeout/hang

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted. Author reviewed the probe deadline ownership and caller-path proof output.
